source_text: Nec quasi blasphemantem me lapidetis dum velim glorificare Spiritum. Mulieres quaerentes quem adsumant apprehendent virum — Christum — ut nomen eius invocetur super eas.
pass_a_gloss: Do not stone me as if blaspheming while I wish to glorify the Spirit. The women seeking whom they may take will seize a man — Christ — so that his name may be invoked over them.
pass_b_english: Do not stone the preacher for glorifying the Spirit. The seven seek a man to take away their shame — and that man is Jesus, whose name is invoked over every gift of the Spirit.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
